curation_note: Real AIM market mornings and real announcement titles are used to benchmark editorial placement. Candidate impact, signal, outlook and analyst language are curated structured inputs representing the existing Smallcaps.ai analyst contract; the benchmark tests the editor, not the underlying Analyst 3.3 model.

cases.description: A solvency failure must lead; a live possible-offer story and debt repayment matter; routine/low-value material should not displace them.

candidates.rns_title: Notice of intention to appoint Administrators
candidates.verdict: Insufficient funds leave administration as the immediate outcome
candidates.what_changed: The board concluded the company has insufficient funds to continue trading as a going concern.
candidates.analyst_view: This is an investment-case failure, not a normal funding update. Solvency now dominates every other consideration.

candidates.verdict: Waterland confirmed among parties discussing a possible offer
candidates.what_changed: Gamma confirmed preliminary discussions with Waterland and other potential offerors.
candidates.analyst_view: The ownership outcome is now a live variable. No offer is certain, but this materially changes the near-term investment case.

candidates.verdict: Takeover Panel disclosure confirms the live offer-period mechanics
candidates.what_changed: Waterland was identified as an offeror and a Rule 2.6 deadline was recorded.
candidates.analyst_view: Useful process confirmation, but it is part of the same Gamma takeover story rather than a separate lead item.

candidates.verdict: Debt repayment reduces near-term balance-sheet pressure
candidates.what_changed: The company reported repayment of debt following its recent financing and readmission activity.
candidates.analyst_view: Balance-sheet improvement matters, although the wider funding and execution history still needs monitoring.

candidates.verdict: Trading update leaves the core investment case broadly unchanged
candidates.what_changed: The company provided a trading update ahead of results without a material guidance change.
candidates.analyst_view: Worth recording, but there is no strong reason for this to compete with the solvency, takeover or balance-sheet stories.

candidates.rns_title: Share Buyback, Rule 9 Waiver and Notice of GM
candidates.verdict: Buyback proposal is capital-allocation relevant but not a morning lead
candidates.what_changed: Springfield proposed a share buyback programme and sought shareholder approval for related Rule 9 waivers.
candidates.analyst_view: Relevant capital allocation, but it does not outrank the morning's solvency, takeover and debt developments.

cases.description: A major clinical/regulatory milestone should lead ahead of an RTO, resource upgrade and ordinary trading/results items; old full-analysis director/options records should disappear editorially.

candidates.rns_title: iSCIB1+ MHRA CTA Approval for Ph3 trial
candidates.verdict: MHRA approval clears a major Phase 3 development gate
candidates.what_changed: The company announced MHRA CTA approval for the Phase 3 programme.
candidates.analyst_view: This resolves a major regulatory dependency and moves the programme into a materially different execution phase.

candidates.rns_title: Completion of RTO & Re-Admission to Trading on AIM
candidates.verdict: Reverse takeover completes and fundamentally resets the listed group
candidates.what_changed: Vast completed the Gulf reverse takeover, fundraising, share consolidation and AIM re-admission.
candidates.analyst_view: This is a structural change to the company and capital base, but the investment case now depends on post-transaction execution.

candidates.rns_title: MRE Upgrade at Pitfield Titanium Project
candidates.verdict: Pitfield resource upgrade strengthens the scale case
candidates.what_changed: Empire announced an upgraded mineral resource estimate at Pitfield.
candidates.analyst_view: A meaningful project de-risking step; the next question is how resource scale converts into economics and development value.

candidates.rns_title: Q4 Operating Results, Dividend Declaration & CFO
candidates.verdict: Operating update is positive but secondary to the morning's structural events
candidates.what_changed: Goldplat reported Q4 operating results alongside a dividend declaration and CFO update.
candidates.analyst_view: Useful operational evidence, but it does not carry the same thesis-changing weight as the regulatory approval, RTO or major resource upgrade.

candidates.rns_title: Half Year Trading Update and Notice of Results
candidates.verdict: Half-year update is useful but not thesis-changing
candidates.what_changed: The company provided a half-year trading update and confirmed its results timetable.
candidates.analyst_view: Monitor the numbers, but this belongs in quick takes unless guidance or cash changes materially.

candidates.verdict: Routine director dealing does not change the investment case
candidates.what_changed: A director dealing notification was filed.
candidates.analyst_view: Record it, but there is no editorial reason to surface it today.

candidates.verdict: Option award is not material enough for the daily note
candidates.what_changed: The company announced an award of share options.
candidates.analyst_view: Retain in the evidence history; suppress from the morning editorial unless dilution or governance becomes material.

cases.description: A clear trading upgrade should lead, with another upgrade and a balance-sheet-positive disposal ahead of ordinary contract and board items.

candidates.verdict: Profit delivery moves above previous guidance with FY27 momentum improving
candidates.what_changed: Gattaca said FY26 underlying PBT would be about £6.1m versus previous £6.0m guidance, with NFI up 11%.
candidates.analyst_view: Good update. Profit conversion improved and the balance sheet remains strong; the key test is whether FY27 hiring demand supports another step up.

candidates.verdict: Full-year outcome moves ahead of market expectations
candidates.what_changed: Petards said improved margins and EBITDA growth support a full-year result ahead of current market expectations.
candidates.analyst_view: A useful earnings inflection. The next proof point is whether order intake and cash conversion sustain the improvement.

candidates.rns_title: Land Sale and Final Deferred Consideration Payment
candidates.verdict: £12m land sale clears the remaining deferred consideration early
candidates.what_changed: Springfield sold land for £12.0m cash and used £6.5m to settle the final deferred acquisition consideration.
candidates.analyst_view: The important point is balance-sheet simplification, not the land-sale headline. It removes a meaningful deferred obligation and improves strategic flexibility.

candidates.verdict: Acquisition adds scale but needs to prove earnings quality
candidates.what_changed: Knights announced the acquisition of THP Solicitors Limited.
candidates.analyst_view: Strategically relevant, but integration, organic growth and cash conversion matter more than the headline acquired revenue.

candidates.verdict: Contract is useful but not enough to change the group thesis
candidates.what_changed: Tekmar announced a new contract.
candidates.analyst_view: Useful commercial evidence, but materiality and margin need to be judged against the size of the group.

candidates.verdict: Board update is worth monitoring but not a top market story
candidates.what_changed: Distil provided an update to previously announced board changes.
candidates.analyst_view: Keep it in company history; no evidence here justifies scarce morning-note attention.

cases.description: A quieter tape must not manufacture a lead simply because some FULL analyses exist.

candidates.rns_title: Interim results for the 6 months ended 31 May 2026
candidates.verdict: Interims are constructive but do not clear the lead-story bar
candidates.what_changed: Synectics published interim results with no thesis-changing guidance event in the benchmark input.
candidates.analyst_view: Good enough to matter, not strong enough to manufacture a dramatic morning lead.

candidates.verdict: Transaction update is relevant but remains execution-dependent
candidates.what_changed: Neo Energy Metals issued an update on the New Beisa transaction.
candidates.analyst_view: Keep monitoring completion and funding dependencies; this does not deserve a manufactured lead today.

candidates.rns_title: Drill Mobilisation at the Tirzzit Copper Project
candidates.verdict: Drill mobilisation starts work but does not yet create a result
candidates.what_changed: The company announced mobilisation for drilling at Tirzzit.
candidates.analyst_view: This creates a future catalyst rather than a current investment-case change.

candidates.verdict: Non-executive appointment does not change the investment case
candidates.what_changed: The company appointed a non-executive director.
candidates.analyst_view: Record in company memory; suppress from the daily editorial.

candidates.verdict: Board change is not material enough for the morning note
candidates.what_changed: The company announced a board change.
candidates.analyst_view: No evidence in this benchmark input justifies scarce editorial attention.
